description_en: Invoke the QueryEmailVerification API to query the email verification result
description_zh: 调用QueryEmailVerification查询邮箱验证结果
kebab_example: aliyun domain query-email-verification --lang en --email abc@aliyun.com --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryEmailVerification

parameters.help_en:
Language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default Value is en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认值为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: User IP address, which can be set to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

ConfirmIp.description_en: IP address of the computer that completed the email verification
ConfirmIp.description_zh: 完成邮箱验证的电脑IP地址

EmailVerificationNo.description_en: Email verification number (by default, a serial number automatically generated by the System)
EmailVerificationNo.description_zh: 邮箱验证编号（默认为系统自动生成的流水号）

GmtCreate.description_en: Creation Time of the mailbox record in the database
GmtCreate.description_zh: 数据库记录的邮箱创建时间

GmtModified.description_en: Update Time of the mailbox record in the database
GmtModified.description_zh: 数据库记录的邮箱更新时间

SendIp.description_en: IP address from which the user initiated the email verification request
SendIp.description_zh: 用户发起邮件验证的IP地址

TokenSendTime.description_en: Sending Time of the email verification token

VerificationStatus.description_en:
Email verification status. Valid values:
0: Waiting for verification.
1: Verification succeeded
VerificationStatus.description_zh:
邮箱验证状态。取值：
0：等待验证。
1：验证成功

VerificationTime.description_en: Specific time when the email verification was completed
VerificationTime.description_zh: 完成邮箱验证的具体时间
